Name: Sydney Brown
Badge: Joining a Conversation
What is one insight you gained from completing the Atwoodian Table yourself that might shape how you introduce it to students?:

One insight I gained from completing the Atwoodian Table myself is that it helped me organize my thinking before writing. I would introduce this slowly and work through part of an example together first.

How does the Atwoodian Table idea compare to how you have taught argument and/or responding to multiple texts in the past?:
The Atwoodian Table is more structured than some of the ways I have taught argument or multiple-text responses in the past. Instead of having students jump right into writing, it helps them organize their evidence between texts first.
What do you notice about the two sets of excerpts in this module (children in fancy restaurants and toddlers and technology)? How do the excerpts work together to invite students to join the conversation? What are some conversations related to topics you teach?:
I noticed both sets of exceprts presnet different viewpoints on everyday topics that people can relate to. The exceprts work together by giving students multiple perspectives, which allows them to compare ideas and support their thinking with evidence. In topics I teach, similar conversations could include homework or school uniforms.
